title.narrative: Contribute towards achieving the targets of National Strategic Plan aligned with End TB Strategy for reducing the burden of TB and MDR-TB in Pakistan - Pakistan (01-Jan-2018-30-Jun-2021)

description.narrative: Pakistan, Tuberculosis, Mercy Corps (MC)This program has the following goals: Contribute to achieving the goal of the national strategy to control TB in Pakistan which is to reduce by 50% the prevalence of TB by 2025 in comparison to 2011. Contribute towards decreasing the prevalence, by at least 5% per year from 2018 onwards, the prevalence of MDR-TB among TB patients who have never received any TB treament. The objectives of this program are: To increase TB case notification (all forms) from 70% of estimated incident cases in 2014-15 to 85% of estimated incident cases by 2020 while maintaining treatment success rate at 91%. To enhance MDR-TB enrollment from 18% of estimated cases in 2014-15 to 33% of estimated by 2020. To increase the number of TB patients who are screened for HIV infection from 3% in 2014-15 to 10% by 2020
